title: Google starts rolling out the Gemini app on Apple CarPlay (11 Nov 2026), globally, to all Gemini users on iOS in every supported Gemini Live language: hands-free Gemini Live chats from the car display (calendar, unread Gmail, rehearsing), interrupt/change topic/pause, chats sync to the iPhone; Google's five setup steps (update app, allow mic, use Gemini Live on the phone once, connect and tap the Gemini icon on CarPlay, start or resume a chat); ChatGPT, Perplexity, Grok, Meta AI and Claude already had CarPlay apps (9to5Mac, Notebookcheck, iGeeksBlog); Gemini Live was already on Android Auto
